textos.O debate gira em torno da caracterização: The debate revolves around the characterization of the protagonist in the script and how that trait works. While most of those who do not recommend the film reject the character as unpleasant and beyond redemption, most of those who recommend it value his openly self-centered, obsessive stance.
textos.grande parte do grupo descreve o persona: A large portion of the group describes the central character as insufferable, selfish and narcissistic, with no arc of growth or moment that sparks empathy, which makes it hard to root for him.
textos.várias reviews reclamam que o filme é lo: Several reviews complain that the film is too long and drags, with stretches where attention wanders and the viewer just waits for it to end.
textos.o grupo aponta subtramas demais que não: The group points to too many subplots that lead nowhere, a sense of a story without direction and unsatisfying conclusions for the narrative threads presented.
textos.parte das críticas considera a performan: A portion of the reviews consider the actor's performance exaggerated, based on shouting and hyperactivity, although others acknowledge effort or talent despite the result.
textos.há incômodo com figuras femininas reduzi: There is unease with female figures reduced to supporting functions, without depth, and with the way abusive relationships are portrayed without nuance.
textos.algumas reviews leem a obra como celebra: Some reviews read the work as a celebration of a white man defeating the foreign other, reinforcing sexism and a logic of American superiority.
textos.Várias reviews medianas elogiam a atuaçã: Several middling reviews praise Chalamet's performance, describing it as intense and capable of carrying the film, although some consider that he is overdoing it or that the character is irritating.
textos.Este grupo destaca que o protagonista é: This group highlights that the protagonist is narcissistic, manipulative and selfish, which makes it hard to root for him and generates discomfort during the viewing.
textos.As reviews medianas apontam que o filme: Middling reviews point out that the film is dragging and too long, with moments that seem to stretch on unnecessarily, hurting the experience.
textos.Algumas reviews elogiam a fotografia e a: Some reviews praise the cinematography and Safdie's direction, describing them as stylish and immersive, although others consider that the style is already repetitive compared with earlier work.
textos.Vários comentários comparam este filme a: Several comments compare this film to Uncut Gems, calling it an inferior version or a repetition of the same formula of an obsessed protagonist in chaotic environments.
textos.Roteiro confuso e falta de foco: Confusing script and lack of focus
textos.As reviews medianas criticam o roteiro p: Middling reviews criticize the script for being scattered and lacking a clear identity, mixing genres and leaving secondary plots poorly resolved.
textos.Muitas reviews positivas consideram a at: Many positive reviews consider Chalamet's performance the film's strongest point, describing it as intense and able to sustain the narrative. Some say he deserved the Oscar, while others highlight his progress compared with earlier work.
textos.Este grupo descreve o protagonista como: This group describes the protagonist as a detestable but fascinating antihero who manipulates everyone around him to reach his competitive goals. Some compare him to a villain with no redemption, while others see a possible lesson in humility at the end.
textos.As reviews positivas frequentemente menc: The positive reviews often mention that the film keeps a frenetic pace and stresses out the viewer, with scenes that give no respite. This trait is seen as a success by some and as a reason for fatigue by others.
textos.A pontuação musical e o desenho de som s: The musical score and sound design are praised for intensifying the sense of urgency and complementing the scenes. Some highlight the soundtrack as one of the film's best elements.
textos.A direção e a fotografia são descritas c: The direction and cinematography are described as impressive, with framing that captures the intensity of the competition and the protagonist's decline. The Safdies' signature is recognized, although some find it repetitive.
textos.O roteiro é visto como criativo e cheio: The script is seen as creative and full of twists, but some feel that the narrative drags or loses focus at certain moments. Even so, the construction of the protagonist's arc is praised.

textos.Dirigido por Josh Safdie, o filme Marty: Directed by Josh Safdie, the film Marty Supreme (2025) is a drama with thriller elements that follows the trajectory of Marty Mauser. The young man is presented as a table tennis prodigy with grand dreams and a daring style of play, but is doubted by other people. Seeking to prove his ability at any cost, he does everything to achieve the recognition he believes he deserves.
textos.A estrutura da narrativa se apoia na exp: The structure of the narrative relies on the direct exposition of an obsessive protagonist, developing through a competitive setting and a considerable running time.
textos.De modo geral, os grupos concordam sobre: Overall, the groups agree on what the film is and disagree on whether it works. Among the vast majority of ratings (~84%), most point to Timothée Chalamet's performance as the central element, while a significant share highlights the narcissistic, obsessive protagonist. In this same segment, a good portion also stress the fast pace and constant tension.
textos.Sob uma perspectiva intermediária, prese: From a middling perspective, present in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~12%), many acknowledge Timothée Chalamet's performance, although several point to unease with the narcissistic, detestable main character, and a considerable number mention the pace and excessive length.
textos.Por fim, para a visão situada numa fraçã: Lastly, for the view held in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~4%), a large portion reject the detestable protagonist with no redemption, while several criticize the excessive length and dragging pace, and a significant share point to a confusing script with no focus.
